title: Apple Watch doesn’t sync task list order accurately
body:
I’m an avid TickTick user who bought an Apple Watch because it was an app marketed as having a good compatibility with the Apple Watch. 

But it doesn’t have a basic functionality of keeping the list order in both lists and complications. I now have to move to Todoist because that app syncs list order accurately and frankly, I love the TickTick functionality so much I’m frustrated that I’m having to make the switch to the Todoist app. Because TickTick, the app I specifically bought the Apple Watch for, doesn’t work properly on the Apple Watch.

Please fix the lists as well as Task complication so that it actually reflects the manually sorted list order of TickTick’s task list. Even if it’s just the Today list. I’ve used this app for a year or two and I would like to continue using it.
